title: Trial by Farmer: Core
description: Core mod for the Trial by Farmer modpack.
body:
Trial by Farmer: Core (TbfCore) is a core mod for Trial by Farmer's 1.1 update and beyond. It integrates mod items, mechanics and recipes with each other, and makes some changes to mods in the pack to prevent sequence-breaking.

This mod does not support use outside of Trial by Farmer, but it may have some limited functionality as long as its hard dependencies are included.

### Features and Changes:
- Paradise Lost's Bloomed Calcite can no longer be made from Calcite using potions (fixes a progression break present in Trial by Farmer 1.0.0)
- Copper, Iron and Steel gears for use in recipes similar to Better With Time's wooden gear
- Missing claymores and knives for modded materials
- Missing tables, siding and other Better With Time blocks for select modded woods and stones
- Amadrys flour, nethercoal dust, netherclay and red nether brick items for recipe consistency purposes

### Credits
Some textures from Better With Time were edited for the gear items (this mod uses the [CC-BY-4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/) license). The knife textures are derivative of the knife textures in Farmer's Delight, which uses the MIT license.
